mapper.select: SELECT point_id AS pointId, ROUND(AVG(mastery_level), 1) AS avgMasteryLevel, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS studentCount, SUM(CASE WHEN mastery_level < #{threshold} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weakStudentCount FROM lp_mastery WHERE class_id = #{classId} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY point_id ORDER BY avgMasteryLevel ASC, point_id ASC
